1) 5m intros + success criteria
2) 25m architecture & integration patterns (Redwood runtime, routing, and fallback policies)
3) 25m live walk-through: sample integration, auth/KMS notes, and perf expectations
4) 20–35m Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

Prework we need from Atlas:
- Short list of expected data flows (one-page)
- Any network constraints (VPC/KMS notes)
- Security questionnaire highlights you want us to address live

Attaching a starter agenda and a short scoping checklist. Vivek (cc'd) — can you pick which engineer will lead the live run-through? Ideally someone familiar with VPC/private deployments.

Cheers,
Kim
